provenance.method: Elevation stored as integer centimetres. `hash` is the app's hash of the unrounded grid at fetch time.
caveats: Terrarium blends sources and includes bathymetry below sea level; it is not bare-earth lidar at street scale.
Both products derive in part from USGS elevation data, so they are not fully independent sources.
3DEP is resampled by the server to the same grid (bilinear); Terrarium by the app (bilinear within tiles).
